key_expressions: Are you ready for the school event?,
How do you feel about this event?,

A: Is the preparation for the school event going well?
Oh really? Sounds smoother than I expected! What’s the atmosphere like?
Nice! I’ll stop by on the event day and take a look.
B: Yes, everything’s going quite well this time!
It feels bright and energetic overall.
Great! You’ll enjoy it even more if you come.

A: Do you have a role in the event?
Oh, giving a short introduction must be a bit nerve-racking!
But I think you’ll do great. Have you practiced a lot?
B: Yes, I’m in charge of a short opening introduction.
Yeah, I’m a little nervous about it.
I practiced quite a bit, so it feels more natural now.

A: Do you think a lot of people will come to the event?
Wow, that many? Sounds like it’s going to be lively!
Nice. Crowded events can be fun in their own way.
B: Yes, probably more than last year.
We promoted it a lot, so people seem very interested.
I’m excited too!

A: Was there anything difficult while preparing for the event?
Ah, it’s tough when schedules get busy.
You’re doing great though! Let me know if you need help.
B: Yeah, it’s hard when schedules overlap.
But working together makes it manageable.
Really? I’ll ask for help if I need it!

A: Which part of the program are you most excited about?
Oh, the performance team? That sounds really fun!
Tell me how it was afterward!
B: I’m most excited for the student performance.
I saw them practicing a bit, and they looked great.
I’ll let you know right after it ends!

A: Do you have someone to go to the event with?
Ah, going alone is fine too! Events are usually crowded anyway.
Still, if you want, I can go with you.
B: Not yet, I haven’t decided.
Yeah, I think it’ll still be fun even if I go alone.
Thanks! Actually, it’d be nice to go together.

A: Are you helping at any of the booths?
Oh, a hands-on booth will probably be really popular!
Great, I’ll definitely stop by your booth.
B: Yes, they asked me to help at a hands-on experience booth.
It’s one of the craft booths, so I heard it gets lots of visitors.
I’d be happy if you stopped by!

A: Did you make any new friends while preparing for the event?
Oh, working together really helps people bond!
Nice, introduce them to me sometime.
B: Yes, I became close to someone naturally during the preparations.
We worked together a lot, so communication felt really smooth.
Sure, I’ll introduce them when there’s a chance!

A: Is there an after-party after the event?
Oh nice! It must be fun to gather with everyone.
Tell me all about it afterward!
B: Yes, we’re going out for a casual dinner.
Everyone wants to relax a bit after the event.
Yep, I’ll tell you everything after I go!

A: Then on the event day, want to walk around together for a bit?
Oh great! It’s better to go around with someone when it’s crowded.
I’ll message you on the day if everything works out!
B: Sure! It’ll be more fun looking around together.
Yeah, it’ll feel less overwhelming if we go as a pair.
I’ll text you in the morning that day!
